figures.finding: A resident under state pension age pays a combined income tax and national insurance rate in box 1 of 35.75% up to EUR 38,883, 37.56% to EUR 78,426 and 49.50% above; there is no regional or municipal income tax.
figures.applies: Income year 2026, under AOW age; box 1 (work and home).

figures.finding: Instead of an allowance, everyone gets a general tax credit of EUR 3,115 (phased out at 6.398% of income above EUR 29,736 to nil at EUR 78,426), and workers a labour credit of up to EUR 5,685 (phased out at 6.51% above EUR 45,592 to nil at EUR 132,920).
The tax year is the calendar year; the income tax return is due by 1 May of the following year.
figures.applies: Ordinary return; a different date may be set in the return letter.

figures.finding: National insurance (AOW, Anw, Wlz: 27.65%) is inside bracket 1; on top, the employer pays unemployment premium AWf (2.74% low, 7.74% high), disability premium Aof (6.27%/7.63%), Wko 0.50%, Ufo 0.68% and the Zvw health levy of 6.10%, all up to EUR 79,409 a year; where the employer does not pay the levy, a 4.85% Zvw contribution is withheld. A self-employed person pays the lower income-related Zvw contribution of 4.85% on contribution income (which includes profit) up to EUR 79,409 by assessment, and, meeting the hours test, deducts EUR 1,200 self-employed allowance (plus EUR 2,123 for a starter) from profit.
figures.applies: 2026 (Handboek Loonheffingen 2026); a self-employed person pays national insurance in bracket 1 and the Zvw contribution by assessment; Whk is employer-specific.

figures.finding: A freelancer's fee bears VAT at 21% unless exempt or at 9%; a business established in the Netherlands with turnover of at most EUR 20,000 a year may use the small-business exemption (KOR); an artist under the artists' scheme charges no VAT on the performance.

sources.said: Het 21%-tarief geldt voor alle goederen en diensten die niet vrijgesteld zijn, en die niet onder het 9%-tarief of het 0%-tarief vallen.
En is uw omzet niet meer dan € 20.000 per kalenderjaar? Dan kunt u gebruikmaken van de kleineondernemersregeling (KOR).
Als de artiest onder de artiestenregeling valt, dan mag hij geen btw in rekening brengen voor het optreden.
